name: Rival Consoles Live
description: British producer Ryan Lee West brings his emotive, human-like electronic music to Porto. Experience his new album in an immersive concert at the city's iconic architectural gem.
longDescription:
Rival Consoles, the stage name of British electronic music producer Ryan Lee West, performs live at Casa da Música on May 1, 2026. Known for his intricate and emotionally resonant electronic compositions, West has released several critically acclaimed albums, blending ambient textures with propulsive rhythms. This concert will feature material from his latest album, offering a live interpretation of his evolving soundscapes.

Attendees can expect an immersive auditory experience within the distinctive architecture of Casa da Música. The concert is designed to highlight the nuanced layers of Rival Consoles' work, creating an atmosphere that balances introspection with dynamic energy. The performance will appeal to fans of contemporary electronic music and those interested in experimental sound design.

Tickets for Rival Consoles Live are available from €15. Casa da Música is located in Boavista and is accessible via Metro (Casa da Música station, lines A, B, C, E, F), as well as numerous bus routes.
